milestones.title: Enquiry received
milestones.criterion: Cited evidence shows a customer asking about catering for an event, with its date and rough guest count.

milestones.title: Date confirmed available
milestones.criterion: Cited evidence shows the business told the customer it can cater on that date.

milestones.title: Proposal sent
milestones.criterion: Cited evidence shows a menu and price reaching the customer.

milestones.title: Contract signed
milestones.criterion: Cited evidence shows the customer accepting the proposal in writing.

milestones.title: Deposit paid
milestones.criterion: Cited evidence shows the deposit received.

milestones.title: Menu finalised
milestones.criterion: Cited evidence shows the customer approving the final menu, including dietary requests.

milestones.title: Final headcount confirmed
milestones.criterion: Cited evidence shows the customer stating the final number of guests. An estimate is not final.

milestones.title: Venue access agreed
milestones.criterion: Cited evidence shows the venue's access time, kitchen and parking arrangements agreed.

milestones.title: Event served
milestones.criterion: Cited evidence shows the event took place with the business serving, such as a staff report or the customer's thanks.

milestones.title: Equipment collected
milestones.criterion: Cited evidence shows all hired or owned equipment collected from the venue.

milestones.title: Final invoice paid
milestones.criterion: Cited evidence shows the balance paid, adjusted for the final headcount.
